posts.title: The Web is for People
posts.description: When it comes to building web sites, building applications, building new platforms and building the underlying standards that support them, I’m a big believer in driving everything by user need. posts.title: Yes, but is it the web?
posts.description: What is the web? posts.title: 2025 Year in Review
posts.description: It’s certainly been an interesting year. And not in a good way. More in an (apocryphal) Chinese curse kind of way. As an immigrant myself, I’m horrified at the scapegoating of immigrants in the US, in the UK and elsewhere.
